tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the devices in the home, optionally for one room.

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Get the current state and last activity of one device.

tools.name: get_energy_report
tools.description: Get energy use for the home or one device over a period.

tools.name: set_thermostat
tools.description: Set the target temperature and mode of a thermostat.

tools.name: schedule_device
tools.description: Schedule a device to turn on, turn off or start at a time.

tools.name: create_automation
tools.description: Create a rule that runs an action when a trigger happens.

tools.name: grant_guest_access
tools.description: Give a guest temporary access to a lock.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a notification message to a household member.

tools.name: post_household_note
tools.description: Post a note to an internal household channel.
